Algorithm 1: initializationGLR (POP_size, all_ope, basic_infor, ope_set, job_num, fa_num)

% all_ope: total number of operations % Chrom_all: the chromosome of an individual
% basic_infor: the set of processing time and energy consumption for each operation
% ope_set: the set of operation number for each job % job_num: total number of jobs
% fa_num: total number of factories % Chrom_os: the OS vector in the chromosome
% Chrom_fa: the FA vector in the chromosome % Chrom_ma: the MA vector in the chromosome

1: rate_G ← 0.6; rate_L ← 0.3; rate_R ← 0.1;
2: Chrom_all ← zeros(3, sum (ope_set));
3: For i = 1: POP_size Do
4: Cumu_time ← zeros(1, fa_num); Cumu_energy ← zeros(1, fa_num); num ← 0;
5: For k = 1: job_num Do
6: oper ← ope_set(1, k); chrom(1, num + 1: num + oper) ← ones(1, oper)*k; num ← num + oper;
7: End For
8: in ← randperm(all_ope); Chrom_os ← chrom(in);
9: If i <= POP_size* rate_G Then % perform global selection method
10: For j = 1: job_num Do
11: compute the minimum processing time for job j in each factory, and define the time set as T_j.
12: Cumu_time ← Cumu_time + T_j;
13: choose the solution with the minimum Cumu_time, and save the corresponding factory and machines of job j into Chrom_fa and Chrom_ma respectively.
14: End For
15: Else If i > POP_size* rate_G && i <= POP_size* (rate_L + rate_G) % perform local selection method
16: For j = 1: job_num Do
17: Find the factory and machine arrangement with the shortest processing time for job j in all factories, and save the corresponding factory and machines of job j into Chrom_fa and Chrom_ma respectively.
18: End For
19: Else % perform random selection method
20: For j = 1: job_num Do
21: For k = 1: ope_set(1, j) Do
22: fa_rank ← randpem(fa_num, 1);
23: generate randomly an available machine ma_rank in factory fa_rank, and save fa_rank and ma_rank into Chrom_fa and Chrom_ma respectively.
24: End For
25: End For
26: End If
27: Chrom_all (1,:) ← Chrom_os; Chrom_all(2,:) ← Chrom_fa; Chrom_all (3,:) ← Chrom_ma);
28: Population(i).chromosome ← Chrom_all;
29: Decode Chrom_all to get decoding information decode_infor and three objectives obj_three;
30: Population(i).decode ← decode_infor; Population(i).objectives ← obj_three;
31: End For
32 Return (Population)
